messages:
Maya Chen: Heads-up — prepping HaloHealth QBR for next Mon. After their bulk import, embedding traffic jumped ~2.6x. Need concise artifacts: 30/90d token-by-route export, scenario spend table (conservative/expected/burst), a short JSON alert snippet we can screenshot, 20m enablement ask, and a one-line renewal exposure. @Evan Liu can you pull route exports? @Rina Patel can you draft the enablement bullets? @Tom Grant pls flag renewal actions.

Evan Liu: On it. Will export tokens per-route + token-per-call dist and drop CSV to shared bucket by EOD. ETA 5pm PT.

Evan Liu: Export uploaded: /shared/exports/halo_tokens_3141592653.csv
CSV snippet:
```route,tokens,est_cost_usd
embeddings.1024,1,220,000,488.00
chat.completion,155,000,62.00
search.reranker,38,000,15.20
```
Observations: embeddings ~78% cost. Token-per-call modal ~25 tokens -> lots of per-item calls. Also see repeated identical inputs; possible client-side dedupe opportunity.

Rina Patel: Enablement (20m) draft: 1) Token anatomy (routes & %); 2) Quick fixes: batching (client bundle), embed multiplexing, client dedupe hash; 3) Embed dim tradeoff (1024 -> 768 experiment) + quick perf caveats; 4) Live snippet + 1-page cheat sheet. I'll attach a simple before/after estimate.

Tom Grant (AE): Renewal exposure: current commit covers ~58% of expected 90d baseline. If usage grows 1.5x they breach limit. Recommend AE outreach when 7d rolling > 80% commit. Offer: short Dedicated trial or prepaid credit top-up. I'll prepare a 1-liner for exec slide.

Finance Bot: Alerting doc: https://redwood.internal/billing/alerts-guidance. Suggested mechanical rule: provisional alert at 75% of commit; escalate at 90% with AE/CS ping and invoice review.

Maya Chen: Two specific asks before I build slides: (A) Evan — add a 50% batching scenario column estimating savings; (B) Rina — 3-bullet "ask" for customer-facing slide; (C) Tom — one-sentence exec recommendation.

Evan Liu: Added sensitivity forecast: /shared/forecasts/halo_sensitivity_3141592653.csv
Summary (monthly equiv): conservative: $720/mo, expected: $2,050/mo, worst_burst_90d: $5,100/mo. Batching 50% scenario -> expected drops to ~$1,200/mo. Assumptions in sheet.

Rina Patel: Enablement slide ask (3 bullets): 1) 20m live session focusing on batching + client dedupe; 2) Ship 1-page checklist + sample JS/Python snippets; 3) Run a 2-week experiment measuring cost/latency tradeoffs (we'll provide a simple A/B telemetry template).

Tom Grant (AE): Exec line: "Recommend AE outreach when 7d rolling spend > 80% of commit; propose short Dedicated trial or credit top-up to reduce renewal friction."

Maya Chen: Can someone paste a tiny JSON alert config we can show on a slide? Simple and visual.

Evan Liu: Example alert snippet for deck:
```json
{
  "name": "halo_token_threshold_v1",
  "metric": "7d_token_rate",
  "threshold_pct": 0.8,
  "window": "7d",
  "notify": ["cs-halohealth","ae-halohealth"],
  "actions": ["slack_notify","create_billing_ticket"]
}
```

Maya Chen: Nice. Also include a mini-savings calc for a dimension-down experiment: what if they try embeddings at 768 dims (approx -20% per-token cost effective) + batching 50%?

Evan Liu: Quick ballpark in the sensitivity sheet: dimension down + 50% batching -> expected ~ $850/mo (from $2,050). I'll annotate assumptions: some quality drift risk; recommend an eval PROMPT set for regen checks.

Rina Patel: I'll add a one-slide before/after micro-case: sample dev loop (current) vs batched + cache flow, with estimated token delta.

Maya Chen: Final sync: tomorrow 10:00am PT to finalize deck. React with :white_check_mark: if you can make it.

Evan Liu: :white_check_mark:

Rina Patel: :white_check_mark:

Tom Grant (AE): :white_check_mark:

Maya Chen: I'll assemble slides and share review link by 6pm today. Also capturing customer feedback: they asked for a short SDK snippet for batching — Rina, can you include that?

Rina Patel: Yup — will include JS + Python batching examples and a minimal telemetry snippet to compute per-call tokens.

Maya Chen: Great team, thanks — will ping if exec asks for an alternate commit scenario.
